== Strategy ==

Just make sure to get Sali to the AC ASAP. Train him to be a warrior with Ket Maliss, and then drop the Saber on him. You can then drain for 2 a turn, and hurt their destinies.

Card choices:

Salicious Crumb: Read his game text, he is the basis of this deck.

Ket Maliss: Trains Sali to be a warrior

DJ Lightsaber: Allows Sali to chop, and adds one to force drains.

Matchups: Ok, you will lose every game with this deck, but you may have some fun.

WYS, Profit, anything TAT based: They will probably come to you after a little while. Just chop one person, and then hop they get a good destiny for you to make them lose.

Anything else: They may not even come to you. But if they do, use above strategy.

Pure space: You will probably get a few decent drains in this matchup.

Thanx for the great deck. i found this really funny and I thought i would bring this over for the people who don't venture often over to DTech :)
